# One case of place_job, on Maya's rooftop-garden app.
case	The runners could not be read, so Maya's machines are taken to be up and the rescue moves the job if they are not
places	order=own,tenki,github wait=10 connected=tenki usual=6
job	linux	pr	self-hosted,linux,pr
keep	on
queued	0
gone	no
now	1793000000
runners	unknown
expect	own	self-hosted,linux,pr	no	-	-
words	This ran on your machines.
